#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -u

ROOT="/Users/kangsangmo/Desktop/Valuehire_v6/worktrees/hs-0002-20260910"
ART="$ROOT/artifacts/hs0002-20260910"
PREFIX="$ART/codeaudit-final"
mkdir -p "$ART"
cd "$ROOT" || exit 2

sha_file() {
  shasum -a 256 "$1" | awk '{print $1}'
}

candidate_sha_json() {
  python3 - "$1" <<'PY'
import hashlib
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

root = Path("/Users/kangsangmo/Desktop/Valuehire_v6/worktrees/hs-0002-20260910")
files = [
    "scripts/acceptance-hs-kickoff-mutations.sh",
    "scripts/verify/has-kickoff-failure.py",
    "humansearch/tests/test_hs_0002.py",
    "humansearch/tests/test_hs_0002_boundaries.py",
    "docs/sot/verification-commands.md",
]
data = {}
for name in files:
    data[name] = hashlib.sha256((root / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
Path(sys.argv[1]).write_text(json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
PY
}

run_logged() {
  local name="$1"
  shift
  local stdout="$PREFIX-$name.stdout"
  local stderr="$PREFIX-$name.stderr"
  local meta="$PREFIX-$name.meta.json"
  local before="$PREFIX-$name.before-sha.json"
  local after="$PREFIX-$name.after-sha.json"
  local started ended rc head_before head_after
  started="$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
  head_before="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
  candidate_sha_json "$before"
  "$@" >"$stdout" 2>"$stderr"
  rc=$?
  ended="$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
  head_after="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
  candidate_sha_json "$after"
  python3 - "$meta" "$name" "$started" "$ended" "$rc" "$head_before" "$head_after" "$stdout" "$stderr" "$before" "$after" "$@" <<'PY'
import hashlib
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

meta, name, started, ended, rc, head_before, head_after, stdout, stderr, before, after, *command = sys.argv[1:]

def digest(path: str) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()

payload = {
    "name": name,
    "command": command,
    "cwd": "/Users/kangsangmo/Desktop/Valuehire_v6/worktrees/hs-0002-20260910",
    "started": started,
    "ended": ended,
    "exit_code": int(rc),
    "head_before": head_before,
    "head_after": head_after,
    "stdout_path": stdout,
    "stderr_path": stderr,
    "stdout_sha256": digest(stdout),
    "stderr_sha256": digest(stderr),
    "candidate_before_sha_path": before,
    "candidate_after_sha_path": after,
    "candidate_before_sha256": digest(before),
    "candidate_after_sha256": digest(after),
}
Path(meta).write_text(json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
PY
  return "$rc"
}

overall=0
chmod +x "$ART/codeaudit-final-probes.py" "$ART/codeaudit-final-runner.sh"

runner_sha="$(sha_file "$ART/codeaudit-final-runner.sh")"
probes_sha="$(sha_file "$ART/codeaudit-final-probes.py")"
{
  printf 'runner_sha256=%s\n' "$runner_sha"
  printf 'probes_sha256=%s\n' "$probes_sha"
} > "$PREFIX-script-sha.txt"

run_logged status-diff bash -lc 'git status --short && git diff --check && git diff --stat && git diff -- scripts/acceptance-hs-kickoff-mutations.sh scripts/verify/has-kickoff-failure.py humansearch/tests/test_hs_0002.py humansearch/tests/test_hs_0002_boundaries.py docs/sot/verification-commands.md' || overall=1
run_logged target-43 bash -lc 'cd humansearch && uv run --no-sync pytest -q tests/test_hs_0002.py tests/test_hs_0002_boundaries.py' || overall=1
run_logged direct-probes python3 "$ART/codeaudit-final-probes.py" || overall=1
run_logged collect-source bash -lc 'cd humansearch && uv run --no-sync pytest --collect-only -q tests' || overall=1
run_logged ruff bash -lc 'cd humansearch && uv run --no-sync ruff check src tests ../scripts/verify/has-kickoff-failure.py' || overall=1
run_logged mypy bash -lc 'cd humansearch && uv run --no-sync mypy src tests ../scripts/verify/has-kickoff-failure.py' || overall=1

exit "$overall"
